# Talox

> Local-first, open-source browser runtime for AI agents: persistent profiles, structured page state, resilient interactions, observability, replay, multi-agent execution and MCP.

This checkout's generated inventory describes v9.0.1. Use the task guide before guessing CLI flags or API methods. Browser launch defaults can select system Chrome; the verified recipes explicitly configure bundled Chromium and isolated temporary profiles. Returned page states may contain `failed` even when a promise resolves.

## Agent guide

- [Start here: task decision table](docs/agent-guide/README.md): Pick the operation, launch safely and understand the state contract.
- [Browse, act, fill, capture and scrape](docs/agent-guide/browsing.md): Exact calls, results, common failures and boundaries.
- [Frames, tabs, workers and replay](docs/agent-guide/orchestration.md): Session isolation, trust and evidence.
- [MCP, local vision, plugins and adapters](docs/agent-guide/integrations.md): Agent transport and extension contracts.
- [CLI flags and defaults](docs/agent-guide/cli-reference.md): Actual parser spellings, positional inputs and traps.
- [Features agents miss](docs/agent-guide/features.md): Discover the less obvious runtime surfaces.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/agent-guide/troubleshooting.md): Source-backed errors, causes and fixes.
- [Verified examples](docs/agent-guide/VERIFIED.md): Executed checks and offline validation limits.
- [Executable offline recipes](docs/agent-guide/examples.mjs): Fixture, assertions and reproducible commands.
